title: Financial Services Cybersecurity vs. ARTEX: Credentials in Plain Sight
content_md: TL;DR 6.9% of finance-linked repos contain secrets: GitGuardian found secrets in 6.9% of active finance-linked public repositories in 2025, versus 5.6% across public GitHub, with 48,819 secrets detected, up 22.9% from 2024. Five minutes from GitHub search to Key Vault: Microsoft documented AI agents searching public GitHub for exposed credentials and reaching Azure Key Vault data in five minutes, while Storm-3358 began using ARTEX against financial institutions in October 2026. 446 sensitive secrets valid at first detection: Of 2,639 sensitive secrets in finance-linked repositories, at least 446 were valid when first detected. Deleting a secret doesn’t invalidate it, so exposed credentials must be revoked or rotated. Microsoft has confirmed that attackers are using ARTEX, an agentic AI penetration testing framework, against financial institutions. In October 2026, a threat group began using the framework to exploit vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications. But web vulnerabilities aren't the only attack path. In a separate investigation, Microsoft documented attackers directing AI agents to search public GitHub for exposed credentials using company names and service-specific keywords. In one case, an agent went from GitHub search to exfiltrating Azure Key Vault data in just five minutes.
